task_name: GB Power System Optimal Dispatch Analysis
objective: Provide optimal power dispatch and system costs for Great Britain power system with high spatial (29-node) and temporal (hourly) resolution

constraints: Power balance at each node (Kirchhoff's Current Law)
Generator capacity limits (P_nom * capacity_factor for renewables)
Storage energy balance and cycling constraints

output_artifacts: Optimal hourly dispatch by generator type and location
System marginal prices at each node
Storage state of charge and cycling
